content:
Track Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals and ongoing $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro — 9to5Toys' Lunch Break headlines today are on the iPhone 17 Pro Max (Renewed Premium) models, which are up to $513 cheaper than the 18 Pro. We also have ecobee's official early fall Prime Day HomeKit deals kicking off today, with up to $210 off smart thermostats and bundles, plus a range of Apple accessory discounts: Solo Loop bands starting from $7, a rare $100 off the Apple Magic Keyboard Folio, and the official MagSafe external battery at 40% off. There's also plenty more deals on chargers, TVs, smart speakers, and more waiting for you below.

Amazon's iPhone 17 Pro Max (Renewed Premium) models now start at up to $513 less than the 18 Pro

We've covered Amazon deals on the iPhone 17 Pro numerous times before, and now alongside the early fall Prime Day deals, we're seeing major discounts on the first batch of unlocked Renewed Premium models. Although the iPhone 18 Pro Max has been discounted, you can now grab a comparably specced 17 Pro for over $500 less. Details below.

The 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max now starts at $1,385.78 with free shipping — $213 less than this model's current new price, and a full $513 below Apple's official 1TB 18 Pro Max pricing.

Apple launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max this month at $1,899. While the 1TB 17 Pro Max didn't sell for that much at launch, with subsequent price increases, you can now grab a genuine discount through Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed inventory.

Only the Deep Blue model is directly marked down to this price at Amazon; other models are still well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max pricing:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (was $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (was $1,599)

Apple's official refurbished store doesn't currently carry the iPhone 17 lineup — what we're seeing is Amazon's highest-quality inventory, complete with a full one-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "battery performance exceeding 90% of original" — these aren't your typical refurbished units.

Here's the current pricing on Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro units:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (was $1,299 new)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro in Silver and Space Gray now $500 off at Amazon

While the latest M5 MacBook Air still has solid low pricing going for it, I wanted to circle back to the $500 discount Amazon is offering — both the Space Gray and Silver models of this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro have dropped to this deep discount.

Amazon has now knocked the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage down to $2,699 with free shipping.

This pricing matches the lowest we've seen over the past few months, and both Space Gray and Silver are in stock — Silver typically doesn't get discounted as often as the black variant.

Apple Solo Loop clearance kicks off: one for $7, two for $10, three for $15 (regular pricing from $49)

Alongside the early fall Prime Day deals, Woot has just launched a full clearance on official Apple Woven Solo Loop and Apple Watch Solo Loop bands. Each band is now just $6.99 with Prime shipping, and an extra 30% off applies at checkout when you buy "two or more."

We've seen plenty of Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but never quite like this one. Expect colors and sizes to sell out fast — this pricing is worth stocking up on.

Solo Loops normally retail for $49, so even grabbing just one is already a steal. But with the extra 30% off when you buy two or more, this is an unbeatable price:

  • Apple Solo Loop $7 (regular pricing from $49)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop $10 (regular pricing from $98)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop $15 (regular pricing from $147)

Colors and sizes are already starting to sell out — I'll keep this short: place your order while stock lasts.

Rare Apple Magic Keyboard Folio for iPad $100 discount lands at Amazon

ecobee official early fall Prime Day HomeKit deals kick off today: up to $210 off smart thermostats and bundles

We're still firmly in early fall Prime Day mode with thousands of deals already live, and ecobee has told 9to5Toys that their official Prime Big Deal Days promotion officially starts today. From today through October 7, you can score discounts on their popular lineup of HomeKit smart thermostats and bundles (saving over $200).

ecobee's official early fall Prime Day deals are now live

Although these deals' product pages don't carry the official Prime Day badge yet, the pricing already reflects the official early fall Prime Day discounts, with many matching what we tracked during the summer Prime Day. Outside of major seasonal promotions, this brand rarely sees so many models slashed this deep at once — if you've been looking to upgrade your smart home, now's the time.

  • Smart Thermostat Premium $210 (was $260)
  • Smart Thermostat Enhanced $165 (was $200)
  • Smart Thermostat Essential $110 (was $140)
  • Smart Doorbell Camera $120 (was $160)
  • SmartSensor for Rooms (2-pack) $75 (was $100)
  • SmartSensor for Doors & Windows $50 (was $80)

Full bundle discounts:

Nearly every full bundle combination now matches — or even beats — the summer official Prime Day event.

  • Total Security and Savings Bundle $370 (was $500) including Smart Doorbell Camera (wired), SmartSensor for Doors and Windows, and Smart Thermostat Premium
  • Total Security Bundle with 1-year Smart Security Advanced $375 (was $580) including Smart Thermostat Premium, Smart Doorbell Camera, SmartSensors, and 1 year of Smart Security Advanced service
  • Comfort and Security Bundle $245 (was $340) including Smart Thermostat Premium, Smart Sensor, 2-pack SmartSensor for Doors and Windows

Twelve South Dual USB-C wall charger with Find My slashed to $37 (53% off)

Spigen magnetic wrist strap slashed to $15 with Prime shipping

Amazon's new Fire TV Stick 4K now on sale at half price, starting from $16

As part of the currently running early fall Prime Day deals, Amazon today launched the new Fire TV Stick 4K — just enter promo code 4KINTRO at checkout to grab it at 50% off the regular price. This killer launch deal joins the early fall Prime Day Fire TV Stick and other streaming device discounts, starting from $16.

Fire TV Stick early fall Prime Day deals:

  • New Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K: $30 (was $60)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick HD: $16 (was $40)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Wi-Fi 6E: $45 (was $85)
  • Amazon Fire TV Cube, 4K Ultra HD, Wi-Fi 6E: $90 (was from $140)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Plus, Wi-Fi 6: $38 (was $70)
  • Amazon Fire TV Alexa Voice Remote Pro: $20 (was $35)

Amazon has now slashed the new Fire TV Stick 4K with the upgraded Fire TV remote to $29.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

Remember to clip the coupon on the page or enter promo code 4KINTRO at checkout.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (was $1,499)

  • Baseus 12-in-1 docking station just $42 — besides elevating your laptop, it adds a whole workstation's worth of ports
  • Spacious 55-inch PU leather desk pad slashed to $26 with Prime shipping
  • Samsung 2026 4K/5K ViewFinity Mac workstation monitors early fall Prime Day deals slash nearly 60% off
  • Bring home a roborock 2026 flagship Qrevo Edge 3 Pro robot vacuum and mop, new low of $1,100, other models from $160
  • Add 6 smart bulbs to your Apple Home for just $5 each (30% off)
  • This Anker iPhone external charger with built-in folding stand is now just $26 (nearly 50% off)
  • New Baseus woven USB-C cables to match your iPhone 18 Pro, from $10

Amazon first to reveal a wave of upcoming early fall Prime Day deals

New M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals return to Amazon (up to $50 off)

Besides this morning's $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, Amazon has also relaunched all launch deals on the new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio.

Both the 2026 Mac mini with the new M6 chip and the higher-end M5 Pro models available at Amazon have dropped back to their historic lows:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (was $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (was $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (was $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (was $1,699)

The new Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and 512GB storage is also $50 off its regular price:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,449 (was $2,499)

While it's not a massive discount, for those looking to upgrade early in the launch window Amazon is currently at the lowest price, and all in-stock models have hit historic lows — heading into the new work week, we wanted to make sure you don't miss these deals.
